friday_designation_momentum_on_productio.description: Friday designation momentum (LEAD-08): revision-timing proxy (date_modified weekday static vs revised-late; the closest available substitute for the unmeasurable per-player Wed/Thu/Fri practice trajectory, since the canonical injury source stores exactly one row per player-week) stacked on PRODUCTION weak_stack via a discrete asymmetric fade rule, opener-graded on the rotation-assigned [2020,2021] window (matches LEAD-62's window).
friday_designation_momentum_on_productio.notes: Base rates (76,554 covered player-weeks, 2010-2024): revised-late class inactive rate 46.89% (n=70,123) vs static class 45.68% (n=6,431); conditional on final practice level the revised-late gap is positive in all three levels (DNP +14.3pp, LP +5.1pp, FP +2.5pp). Team-game feature = trailing snap share (role_share, reused from the injury-value construct) x season-lagged walk-forward P(inactive|class). Positive control (candidate replaced by realized margin) on the same window: +46.71 points, P+ 1.0 -- harness proven sensitive.
friday_designation_momentum_on_productio.plain_summary: Flagging a team when a starter's injury report got revised late in the week (versus settling early) and fading that team does not clearly beat today's picks; the 2020-2021 test leans slightly against it but is too small to be sure either way.

Per-season sign is mixed: 2020 +0.4545 P+0.712, 2021 -1.2712 P+0.123, 2022 +1.6129 P+0.822, 2023 0.0 (tie), 2024 -0.7519 P+0.153, 2025 0.0 (no coverage).
friday_designation_momentum_on_productio.plain_summary: Across every season the site currently grades, this flag flips about as many right picks to wrong as wrong picks to right, so on its own it neither clearly helps nor clearly hurts.
